name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 18, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Certificate of Appreciation to Dr. Beatriz Villareal
4B.
Presentation of Proclamation for Small Business Saturday
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 21, 2020 Regular Meeting, October 28, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session, and the October 28, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-11-18 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Analyst McShane
Approve the Warrants.
2020-11-18 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Revisions and Consolidation of the Facility Use Reservation Policies for the Encinitas Community Center, Senior Center, Encinitas Library Community Room and Literacy Lab. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
1) Review and approve revision to the Community and Senior Center Facility Use Reservation and Fee Policy CSC001; 2) Approve deletion of the Encinitas Library Community Room Use Policy C023, and the Encinitas Library Literacy Lab Policy C026; and 3) Approve merging information from the library policies in Policy CSC001 renamed Encinitas Indoor Facility Reservation and Use Policy.
2020-11-18 Item 08C Revisions and Consolidation of the Facility Use Reservation Policies
8D.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2020-10, which proposes amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan to update the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit (JADU) development standards based on updates to State Law that became effective on January 1, 2020.   Contact Person: Planner IV Plagemann
Adopt Ordinance No. 2020-10 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Address Changes in State Law Regarding Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-11-18 Item 08D ADU Update Ordinance Adoption
8E.
Annual Report Concerning the Mitigation Fee Act for Fiscal Year 2019-20. Contact Person: Assistant Finance Director Gallup
Review and file the Annual Mitigation Fee Report for Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2020.
2020-11-18 Item 08E Mitigation Fee Act of Fiscal Year 2019-20
8F.
To initiate the solicitation of a Request for Proposals for the El Camino Real Corridor Specific Plan and amend the FY 2020-21 Adopted Budget to appropriate $300,000 in LEAP grant funding for the development of the Specific Plan.  Contact Person: Planner IV Zornes
1) Direct staff to release the draft Request for Proposals (RFP) for the El Camino Real Corridor Specific Plan (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and  2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-96 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report) authorizing LEAP grant funding of $300,000 for a consultant to develop the El Camino Real Corridor Specific Plan.
2020-11-18 Item 08F ECRC Specific Plan RFP
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Update to the 2018 Climate Action Plan in accordance with mitigation measure GHG-2 of the environmental assessment for the 5th Cycle Housing Element Update. Contact Person: Climate Program Administrator Najera
Adopt Resolution 2020-98, titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving and Adopting the 2020 Update of the City of Encinitas Climate Action Plan” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-11-18 Item 10A CAP Update
10B.
Ordinance No. 2020-16 regulating group homes, including sober living homes, operating in the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2020-16 titled, “An Ordinance of The City Council of the City Of Encinitas, California, Amending Titles 2, 9 And 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, Encinitas Ranch, and Cardiff-By-The-Sea Specific Plans, and the Local Coastal Plan Relating to Group Homes and Sober Living Facilities (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).”
2020-11-18 Item 10B Group Homes Regulation Introductory Ordinance
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Presentation on the Citywide Pavement Survey and Update describing the City's Pavement Management Program, and the current overall network condition. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Receive the oral presentation.
2020-11-18 Item 11A Pavement Management Program - City Council Presentation
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS WILL BE A SPECIAL MEETING ON DECEMBER 8, 2020, AND A REGULAR MEETING ON DECEMBER 9, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
